# zapleo — Dmitriy Zaporozhets

> Operator-turned-educator. 12 years of Ukrainian web agency work, now running an IT academy branch in Jakarta. Personal site at zapleo.com.

## About

Dmitriy Zaporozhets is a software operator and EdTech professional based in Jakarta, Indonesia. He founded a web agency in Dnipro, Ukraine in 2010, delivered 40+ client projects over 12 years, then pivoted to education — currently serving as Branch Director at IT STEP Academy Jakarta (since April 2026).

His public persona (handle: @zapleosoft, brand: zapleo) sits at the intersection of software engineering, operator-level business management, and AI-augmented education.
